notes.title: Will It Run on Steam Deck? Absolutely!
notes.notes: [p]People have been asking us: “Will it work on Steam Deck?”[/p][p][/p][p]Short answer: yes. Slightly longer answer: we wanted it to be Steam Deck–first from the start, so we’d have to try pretty hard to make it not work at this point.[/p][p][/p][p]Even though Slumbering Woods is still early in development, we built it with controllers in mind from day one (we're still working on the mouse support though 😅). The menus behave and the buttons do what you expect. [/p][p][/p][p]And on the Steam Deck? We were pleasantly surprised how good it looks and feels - the screen size suits the art, the colours pop on the OLED screen, and it’s just cosy. We think the best way to play cosy games is on a couch or in bed, wrapped in warm blankets with a cup of hot tea (you can probably guess it’s winter here now).[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="IKw0ELsPs9k;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: As we're catching code bugs, we've added some bugs for you to catch too!
notes.notes:
Hello, Slumbering Woods adventurers! 

We’ve been working hard on improving the planting mechanics and are excited to share that we’ve made great progress! Plants will soon be even more important in your journey through the mystical woods. Not only will they help shape the environment, but they will also play a key role in solving puzzles and unlocking new areas.

In addition to plants, we’ve started adding bugs to the game! These little critters aren’t just for decoration; players will be able to catch them and use them to solve puzzles. We’re sure these new additions will add an exciting twist to your gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220901/7e99baef94001938019f8714cef3ba9f2262e9c6.png[/img]

To give you a sneak peek of these exciting changes, we’ve created a brand-new gameplay video showcasing the latest features! Check it out and see how the planting mechanics and bug-catching work in action.

[previewyoutube=CHATJZ9KxIA;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re currently working on refining the planting puzzles, and we’re planning to release a demo later this year. In the meantime, if you’re eager to try the game, come join us on our Discord server for updates, sneak peeks, and to chat with other fans of Slumbering Woods.

Thank you for all your support. We can’t wait to share more soon! 

Wishlist now for more updates!

notes.title: 🌿 Our First Devlog Is Live: Let’s Grow Something Special! 🌿
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 👋

We’re so excited to share something special with you today - our very first devlog for Slumbering Woods is live on YouTube! 🎉

In this video, we’re giving you a cosy peek into the world we’re building. You’ll get to learn more about the game, the planting mechanics, and some of the features we’ve been working on. Plus, we’re sharing a bit about our small indie team and why Slumbering Woods means so much to us.

📺 Watch the devlog here: [url=https://youtu.be/IaCKWuCeiNI]Slumbering Woods Devlog #1[/url]

We’re still in the early stages of development, but we have so many exciting plans for the future, and we’d love for you to join us on this journey. Let us know what you think of the devlog, and feel free to share any ideas or feedback in the comments—we’d love to hear from you! 💬

Thank you for your support so far. It means the world to us. 🌲 Stay tuned for more updates, and we’ll see you in the woods!
